note: One entry per dispatch printed on the page, in page order. Every URL below was opened and read while building this entry, and every page declares a 24 November 2026 publication date; the raw date string the page itself carries is quoted in date_on_page. Three dispatches from an earlier draft were dropped for want of such a page: Paris (Le Havre port authority inquiry), Jakarta (treason charge against a former police chief) and Kanton (Kiribati evacuation, published 23 November). Two more were replaced when their pages were reopened: the London Tube item, because The Standard's page is dated 25 November 2026, now cites Anadolu's report of the same day; the Suva COP31 item, because the Post Courier page could not be retrieved, now cites The Fiji Sun. Both replacements were opened and are dated 24 November 2026.

stories.headline: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort
stories.attribution: The mine strikes are the IRGC navy's account, carried by Iranian state media; the sanctions count is the U.S. Treasury's.

stories.headline: Houthis hit Riyadh's tallest tower, 11 wounded, Saudi Civil defense says
stories.attribution: The 11 wounded, the description of the tower as the capital's tallest and the 'second Houthi strike' framing are Saudi civil defence's, as reported.

stories.headline: 23 injured after car bomb explodes outside government offices in Colombia
stories.attribution: The toll is attributed to 'authorities' on the page, which describes regional government offices as the site; it names no claim of responsibility and carries no police statement.

stories.headline: How major US stock indexes fared Tuesday 11/24/2026
stories.publisher: The Globe and Mail, carrying The Associated Press markets table
stories.attribution: Index levels and percentage moves are the AP table's closing figures.

stories.headline: Democrat Victoria Broderick unseats eight-term Republican incumbent in Tennessee
stories.attribution: The 259-seat total rests on the Associated Press race call cited in the report; the page says nothing about the size of the majority.

stories.headline: Claudia Sheinbaum exhorta al INE a revisar lineamientos de adquisiciones en OPLES
stories.attribution: 'Mafia electoral' is President Sheinbaum's own phrase; she asked the INE's general council to review the hiring and procurement rules of the state electoral bodies.

stories.headline: Lower House passes fiscal bill in decisive vote
stories.date_on_page: 24/11/2026 06h16 (the vote itself was cast on 23 November)
stories.attribution: The 353-128 count is the chamber's recorded vote as reported; the exchange rate is the outlet's market note for Monday, when the real weakened to around R$6 per dollar.

stories.headline: Russian overnight attack injures 22 in Zaporizhzhia
stories.attribution: The two dead and 22 wounded are a regional defence official's figures, as reported.

stories.headline: Russian retaliation over Ukrainian refinery strikes is inevitable, Putin says
stories.attribution: The word 'inevitable' is President Putin's, quoted by the outlet.

stories.headline: Latvian President sees potential turning point in Ukraine war next year
stories.attribution: The forecast is President Edgars Rinkevics's: a tipping point that could come in spring or summer. The page carries no prediction of a Russian defeat.

stories.headline: EU imposes hard import quotas on Chinese hybrid cars, sweeping in UK and Japan
stories.attribution: The quotas cover hybrid cars from China, Britain, Japan and others, as reported from EU officials; the page cites no regulation text.

stories.headline: Volkswagen labor talks end without deal as union warns of January strikes
stories.attribution: The strike warning is IG Metall's; the no-deal account is the union's and the company's.

stories.headline: London Tube drivers to go on strike as talks over working conditions fail
stories.attribution: The strike call, the Thursday start at noon and the dates of the further walkouts are the RMT's, as reported. This page replaces a Standard article that turned out to be dated 25 November.

stories.headline: DR Congo: Concern for trapped Ebola workers as violence against women and girls deepens
stories.attribution: The account of the trapped staff and the maternity ward is the World Health Organization's, reported by UN News.

stories.headline: Alamata shelling killed 14 civilians, Amnesty says
stories.attribution: The 14 dead and the call for a war crimes inquiry are Amnesty International's.

stories.headline: Outrage as 28 women, girls abducted, 15 cases of sexual violence against minors reported in Sudan's Blue Nile state
stories.attribution: The 28 abductions and the 15 cases of sexual violence against girls under 18 are the SIHA Network's, which blames the RSF and allied militias; the page is a report on the network's statement, not a monitor's tally.

stories.headline: West Africa: Gold Refining Projects Already Exceed Mining Production
stories.attribution: The 585 tons of gold output and the finding that refining projects launched or announced since 2024 would exceed it come from a Reuters survey, as carried by the outlet.

stories.headline: Three Palestinians Martyred, Five Injured in Khan Younis Strike
stories.attribution: The toll is WAFA's, as reported; Israel's account of the target is not carried on the page.

stories.headline: Iraq Moves To Take Control Of Oilfields, Border Crossings In Kurdish Region
stories.attribution: The order is the prime minister's, as reported: the Oil Ministry to take over oilfields and border forces to shut unofficial crossings. The page describes an instruction, not a completed takeover, and carries no Kurdish reaction.

stories.headline: South Korea scrambles jets as Russian warplanes enter air defense zone
stories.attribution: The scramble and the incursion are South Korea's account, as reported; no airspace violation was reported.

stories.headline: Hasina's December 16 homecoming plan: Bangladesh says ex-PM can be brought back only through extradition
stories.attribution: The 16 December plan is Sheikh Hasina's announcement; the position that she can only be brought back by extradition is a state minister's, as reported.

stories.headline: Singapore upgrades GDP forecast to around 6% for 2026, expects growth to moderate in 2027
stories.attribution: The 6.1% year-on-year growth, the 2026 forecast and the 2027 outlook are the Ministry of Trade and Industry's; 5.4% is MTI's own advance estimate.

stories.headline: Taiwan Weighted Closes 8.99% Higher on AI Rebound
stories.attribution: The close, the point gain and the percentage are the exchange's figures; the AI-rebound reading is the outlet's.

stories.headline: Gas explosion in Hanoi kills six, injures 10
stories.attribution: The toll and the description of a suspected gas explosion at an eatery are officials' account as reported; the gas leak is the likely cause, not a finding.

stories.headline: Japan boosts ICC funding amid US sanctions threat
stories.attribution: Payment of Japan's 2027 dues by year-end is Japan's pledge; the April sanctions deadline is the U.S. measure's, as reported.

stories.headline: China's Shenzhou 24 mission lifts off, carrying first foreign astronaut to its space station
stories.attribution: The crew manifest is China's space programme's; the 'first foreign astronaut' framing is the outlet's.

stories.headline: Xiamen Airlines signs deal for 50 Boeing 737-8s
stories.attribution: The $7.4bn is the list price of the order, not a disclosed payment, and the page reports the order as pending approval.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands signs treaty with Australia that checks China's influence in the South Pacific
stories.publisher: The Associated Press, via The Spec
stories.attribution: The page, dated 24 November, reports the treaty with Australia and the rejection of the 2022 China defence deal; the signing itself took place in Canberra on 25 November local time.

stories.headline: 'When it mattered' Australia failed Pacific at COP31, elders say
stories.attribution: The charge that Australia sided with fossil fuel producers and lobbyists rather than island nations is the Pacific Elders' Voice's. This page replaces a Post Courier article that could not be retrieved.

stories.headline: Malaysia to repatriate another 6,803 Myanmar nationals despite ICJ genocide ruling
stories.attribution: The 6,803 figure and the reference to the ICJ genocide ruling are as the page's headline and opening report give them.
